title: Ted's Shop
intro: Hand-picked supplies for cats and dogs, chosen from years of caring for rescues. Every order helps pay for a rescue's treatment.
soon: Message us if you see something you like, and we will let you know when it is ready.
ted_body:
Ted was one of our rescue cats, and the one who taught me the most. Caring for him was a long journey, and through it I learned how to care for cats with jaw problems, broken bones, and cats who cannot see. Along the way I tried so many tools and supplies: some went straight in the bin, and some made life so much easier.

We lost Ted, but everything he taught me stays with us. This shop carries his name so his story can keep helping other animals. Here you will only find the things I truly trust and use with our own rescues.
